verdict.rationale: Release Pipelines let users define stages with "triggers and actions" that move flags through environments and audiences automatically, including auto-generating change requests on promotion to production. Scheduled flags apply changes at a set time, and audit-log webhooks push change events to external systems. That automation is scoped to flag rollouts, though, and the docs do not describe which events can serve as triggers. Missing for 10: a general event-driven rule engine (e.g., metric- or error-triggered actions such as auto-disable), documentation of the available trigger and event types, outbound webhooks beyond audit logs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
